maya (Docs): Heads-up — we need a short FAQ + migration snippet for teams switching from 8-bit -> 4-bit quant and the microbatching changes. Planning a tiny PR to the docs repo. Anyone got perf numbers or known blockers?

jon (Eng-runtime): I can supply a quick perf table. On A10 4-bit tends to give ~1.8x throughput vs our 8-bit baseline, but there can be a small change in token-level quality for some instruction-tuned models. Will paste numbers in a bit. :mag:

seb (ML): Note for Dedicated customers: KV-cache semantics under microbatch=1 are unchanged, but prefix caching needs to be explicitly enabled in runtime config for older deployments. I'll draft the note.

maya (Docs): Great — we should also include an SDK snippet showing the new param names (we renamed a couple in v0.13). Plus a migration note for pinning quant profiles so customers don't accidentally get fallback changes.

jon (Eng-runtime): SDK snippet for v0.13: we use `microbatch` (not batch_size) and `quant_profile`. Example:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(model='rwd/llama-13b', microbatch=8, quant_profile='4bit-gamma')
print(resp.text)
```
Also call out that runtime may fallback to 8-bit if a 4-bit kernel isn't available in-region.

alin (Platform): Add an explicit note: Hosted endpoints may auto-fallback to 8-bit on regions where 4-bit kernels aren't built yet. Recommend a per-route policy to enforce fallback behaviour or to return an error if 4-bit is required.

maya (Docs): Copying that into the draft. Can @seb and @jon review for technical accuracy? Target branch: `docs/optkit/quant-microbatch-migration`.

deploy-bot: PR opened — `2119990000-quant-batch-migration-faqs.md` (checks running) :ci:

jon (Eng-runtime): Another config example for the YAML-based runtime config: 
```yaml
model:
  name: rwd/llama-13b
  quant_profile: '4bit-gamma'
  microbatch: 8
```
Include that under "Runtime config examples".

seb (ML): Add a short QA caveat: "Some instruction-tuned models may show slight drop in few-shot accuracy at 4-bit; run our eval harness against your critical prompt set before rolling out." Link to eval harness: https://go.redwood/evals (placeholder).

maya (Docs): Drafted a short QA checklist in the PR: run docs lints, run the quick perf script in examples/, verify console telemetry for token cost doesn't spike unexpectedly, confirm rollout instructions for Dedicated. I'll ping when it's ready for review.

alin (Platform): Also remind operators that if a customer pins a model SHA in Dedicated, automated rollout to a 4-bit profile won't happen — manual rollout required. Add that to the "What to watch for" section.

maya (Docs): Will add a short Terraform variable migration snippet too (we renamed `batch_sz` -> `microbatch`). Plan to merge Thursday EOD unless someone flags an issue.

seb (ML): :+1: No objections. I'll do a quick smoke run tomorrow and paste the results here.

jon (Eng-runtime): I'll add a small bench script to `examples/bench/quant_microbatch.py` and link it in the PR.

maya (Docs): Thanks all — I'll also add a small CHANGES.md entry and a one-paragraph "why this change" blurb so product managers can forward it to customers if needed.

(seb (ML) reaction): :eyes:

(maya (Docs) reaction): :wave:
